Subject: [UAI] latent Dirichlet allocation (code available)

Dear UAI colleagues:

I am writing to announce that we have made available a C implementation 
of the variational inference and variational EM algorithms described in 
the 2003 JMLR paper "Latent Dirichlet allocation."

The code can be found at:

	http://www.cs.berkeley.edu/~blei/lda-c/

Please feel free to email me with any questions or suggestions.

Sincerely,
David Blei
